reasons.plausibility: Forming a protective oxide scale by adding Al or Cr to a high-entropy alloy is scientifically valid for improving oxidation resistance, but it does not directly address how to reduce residual thermal stresses or simplify complex AM processing.
reasons.testability: While comparing mass gain offers a measurable outcome, it does not fully validate the hypothesis regarding stress and mechanical performance, so the proposed test is incomplete.
reasons.usefulness: Focusing on oxide-scale formation only partly relates to the question’s emphasis on residual stress and processing complexity, so the hypothesis has limited applicability to the stated problem.
